evidence_items.explanation: The report identifies easing in AI-related credit and attributes it to reduced expected bond supply. This challenges the exclusive earnings explanation, although the examples chiefly concern hyperscalers rather than a measured neocloud borrower group.
The announcement schedules the third-quarter results call for November 10, after the evaluation date. It establishes timing but does not rule out market anticipation of strong results.
